trigger.what: Prospector’s weekly sweep found 41 candidates; 6 cleared the 70-point affinity threshold, the most in a single week this year.
Fad-vs-Trend Classifier flagged three of the six as fads with 12–18 month evidence windows — worth showing rather than filtering out silently.
Sourcer matched four candidates to existing supplier capability, two of them at tooling we already own.

constraints.label: Preferred-supplier constraint
constraints.detail: A candidate must be makeable by one of our four existing suppliers, or it needs a documented exception. New supplier onboarding is a separate decision with its own cost.

constraints.label: Brand fit
constraints.detail: Durable, repairable, plainly built. Nothing single-use, nothing that reads as novelty, nothing whose main appeal is that it is currently on a feed.

constraints.label: Sampling capital
constraints.detail: $24K this cycle. Sample spend on a parked concept is not recoverable, so parking early is cheaper than sampling hopefully.

constraints.label: No launch decision here
constraints.detail: This flow ends at "worth sampling" or "parked with a trigger". The launch itself is a different decision with a different gate — S9.8.
